name: link_empty
body:
Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Range("J1").Value = "x"
Range("J2").Value = "y"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(6, 0, 0, 90, 60)
sh.ControlFormat.List = Array("a", "b", "c")
sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
sh.ControlFormat.MultiSelect = 2
sh.DrawingObject.Selected(1) = True
sh.DrawingObject.Selected(3) = True
On Error Resume Next
sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
n = Err.Number
On Error GoTo 0
Report = CStr(n) & "|" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & "|" & sh.ControlFormat.ListFillRange & "|" & _
CStr(Range("H1").Value) & "|" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.MultiSelect) & "|"
For i = 1 To sh.ControlFormat.ListCount
Report = Report & sh.ControlFormat.List(i) & ":" & CStr(sh.DrawingObject.Selected(i)) & ";"
Next i
